description: This file defines the EntityNodeType class for migrating node type entities in Drupal, including methods for retrieving and importing entity data, and configuring field and display settings.

classes.name: EntityNodeType
classes.description: Migration destination class for node type entities, extending EntityConfigBase, handling entity retrieval and import with configuration of fields and display settings.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Retrieves the node type entity and ensures description and help text are not empty.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Handles the import of node type entities, deprecated in Drupal 11.3.0, and sets up the 'body' field and display configurations if 'create_body' property is set.
